text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Narita Taishin—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
What do you mean 'what's wrong'...
You can see for yourself if you look over there.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking where Narita Taishin pointed,
there was a claw crane game filled with plushies themed after Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I heard that's trending lately.
Not that I'm interested, though.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"I see girls with it attached to their bags
every now and then."
choice_data_list: Why not try putting it on?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Were you listening to me?
I told you I'm not interested—
choice_data_list: The plushie is really well-made, too!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...*Sigh*. Do whatever you want.
Just so you know, I'm not doing it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"If you want it done, do it yourself.
...Not that I know if you can actually get it, though."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
